name: Quiet Multitude
description: Spread a quiet multitude of phantoms through the field so that no soul can say how many stand there.

name: Unnumbered Shade
description: Stand more shades round the student than any strike can count so that each takes one share of a blow.

name: Multitude Rend
description: Rend the souls of those in front with a single sweep of the multitude.

name: Cloaked Passage
description: Pass among the phantoms cloaked in their number and step out of the one the opponent is not watching.

name: Procession Eternal
description: Set a procession of phantoms walking endlessly round the field so that opponents lose all hold on direction.

name: Vacant Presence
description: Leave a vacant presence on an opponent's soul that empties out the force of its techniques.

name: Unraveled Self
description: Unravel into the multitude as a strike lands and cast the whole force of it back at the one who struck.

name: Hundred Mirrors
description: Raise a hundred mirrors of the student's soul so that every opponent sees their own attack answered from each.

name: Eternal Likeness
description: Fix a likeness that does not fade and make it the face the world sees so that the student is shielded behind it.

name: Myriad Shades
description: Loose ten thousand shades over the field so that each strikes a soul at its own pace and the whole is a flood of blows.

name: Wraith Cataclysm
description: Break the multitude over a vast stretch of ground so that the souls within it are torn at up to the ruinous ceiling of a divine soul.

name: Unnumbered Self
description: Divide the soul into countless phantoms of which each is wholly the student so that the student stands in every place a phantom stands and no wound can be found in any single body; each use is a Part 27 consequence event.
